meta.description: End-to-end Proteina-Complexa design pipeline driver. Use when the user wants to design a binder, run complexa design, de novo binder, design proteins for target, protein binder design, ligand binder, design a small-molecule binder, AME motif scaffolding, scaffold a motif near a ligand, motif + ligand design, enzyme scaffolding, flow matching protein design, beam-search binder, FK steering, MCTS protein design, or refold with AF2/RF3/ESMFold, or wants success rates, interface pAE, scRMSD, or FoldSeek diversity from one command.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or results; uses documented metrics (ipAE, pLDDT, scRMSD, FoldSeek TM-score); references real tools and checkpoints from NVIDIA/community sources

practice_boundaries.detail: Computational protein design tool with no medical diagnostic claims; appropriate for research use

methodological_ground.detail: Appropriate use of flow matching for generation, reward-guided search, independent refold validation with different backends; no methodological fallacies

code_usability.detail: Wraps existing complexa CLI with proper validation step; bash commands syntactically correct; Python snippets (atomworks ligand rename) valid; dependency requirements clearly stated

functional_suitability.note: Complete 7-step workflow covering preflight, pipeline selection, parameter gathering, validation, execution, result collection, manifest emission; covers 3 pipeline variants (protein/ligand/AME); validation step prevents mid-run failures; missing explicit error recovery for interrupted runs

reliability.note: Preflight validation before GPU spend, complexa validate command catches config errors upfront, detailed troubleshooting table with 6 common failure modes; lacks retry logic or checkpoint restart guidance

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 336 lines (significantly exceeds ideal <150); uses 3 reference files for additional details but main file is very dense with inline tables, command examples, and pipeline comparisons

agent_usability.note: Clear 7-step structure with numbered sections; excellent pipeline comparison table; hardware requirements explicit; troubleshooting table helpful; very high complexity (3 pipelines, multiple search algorithms, 4 refold backends, 10+ override parameters)

human_usability.note: Clear section headers and comparison table; 336-line main file requires significant scrolling; pipeline cheat sheet is helpful but could be in reference; AME-specific RF3 ligand renaming gotcha buried in middle of document

security.note: Environment variables for paths (AF2_DIR, RF3_CKPT_PATH); no hardcoded credentials; validation step prevents malformed configs; missing explicit dual-use screening (unlike complexa-binder-design)

maintainability.note: Good modularity with 3 reference files (pipelines.md, overrides.md, troubleshooting.md); pipeline selection via YAML swap is clean; version-pinned checkpoints; no mention of tests or CI/CD

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision with comprehensive keyword list; uses AskUserQuestion for parameters; composes with complexa-target and complexa-evaluate-pdbs skills; deterministic via run_name; references shared skills directory; could improve progressive disclosure (336 lines too dense)

recommendations.title: Significantly reduce main SKILL.md token cost
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md is 336 lines, more than 2× the ideal <150 line target. Performance/Context scored only 3/8. Dense inline content includes full pipeline comparison table, command examples, override table, troubleshooting table.
recommendations.root_cause: Comprehensive coverage with inline tables and examples instead of progressive disclosure to reference files.
recommendations.fix: Move pipeline comparison table to reference/pipelines.md (already exists), move override table to reference/overrides.md (already exists), move troubleshooting table to reference/troubleshooting.md (already exists). Keep only essential 7-step workflow structure and pointers in main SKILL.md. Target <180 lines.

recommendations.title: Add dual-use screening guidance
recommendations.problem: No explicit dual-use warning like complexa-binder-design has. Protein design can have dual-use implications (toxin engineering, pathogen enhancement).
recommendations.root_cause: Security category scored 11/12; missing proactive dual-use screening.
recommendations.fix: Add Responsible Use section similar to complexa-binder-design: 'De novo protein design is dual-use. Decline requests aimed at enhancing pathogen fitness, toxin potency, or bioweapon function; keep designs to legitimate research and therapeutic intent.'

recommendations.title: Add checkpoint restart guidance for interrupted runs
recommendations.problem: No guidance on resuming from checkpoint if pipeline is interrupted mid-evaluation (e.g., OOM crash, timeout). Reliability 2.3 would score higher with recovery documentation.
recommendations.root_cause: Functional completeness gap for error recovery scenarios.
recommendations.fix: Add to troubleshooting.md or new reference/recovery.md: how to resume from ./inference/ and ./evaluation_results/ checkpoints, which stages can restart independently, when to re-run vs continue from artifacts.
